name: Qwen3.6 27B NVFP4
recipeNote: `recipe` is a howtospark.com recipe SLUG, not a URL — it is the join key, and the site refuses to ingest a target naming a recipe that does not exist.
why: Chosen as target 01 because its cross-boot determinism is MEASURED, not assumed. On 2026-07-28 this exact model and pinned config produced byte-identical greedy output across three separate boots, twice over — once with --enforce-eager and once with cudagraphs on. Gates 2 and 3 compare two server processes, so that property is the precondition for ranking anything on this engine at all.
serveArgsNote: Every one of these is a determinism pin, not a tuning choice, and changing any of them invalidates the goldens. --max-num-seqs 1 sets the profiling batch shape and is the prime suspect for the earlier cross-boot failure (batch shape already flips the argmax on this part at n=2); --kv-cache-memory-bytes stops the pool being sized from profiled free memory, which would change block count and therefore attention tiling; --max-model-len and --gpu-memory-utilization pin the rest of the profiling shape. Cudagraphs are deliberately LEFT ON: measured identical across boots either way, so the arena does not have to pay --enforce-eager.

referenceHashes.note: First 16 hex of the sha256 of a fixed 192-token greedy completion, measured 2026-07-28 on spark-05cc, 3 boots each. Recorded as provenance for the determinism claim — the target's real goldens live in goldens.json and are produced by `baseline`.
